title: Ledger Investigates Fund Losses Tied to Southeast Asian Reseller After Implant Found in Device
summary: Bitcoin Magazine Ledger Investigates Fund Losses Tied to Southeast Asian Reseller After Implant Found in Device Ledger has reassured users after people who bought signing devices from a Malaysia-based reseller reported losing funds. This post Ledger Investigates Fund Losses Tied to Southeast Asian Reseller After Implant Found in Device first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Mathew Di Salvo .
